name: A1-39
description: Roscoe's lunar launch vehicle: four white SLS-style boosters, a gray methane core with fins and landing legs, a red methane second stage, and the lunar stack.
notes: Layout from Roscoe's blueprint (A1-39-001). Dimensions from the blueprint; masses are free-design estimates.
Defaults chosen for Roscoe's open decisions: Raptor 2 core engines, SLS boosters, one Raptor Vacuum on the red stage, fins on the core.
Nine core engines: the drawing shows about five, but the sim needs more to lift a full core.

Boosters come down on parachutes. The core has legs, but landing it is off by default: holding back landing fuel leaves too little for the Moon with this design. Turn on "Land the core" in the builder to see the trade-off.
